function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity via Date of Birth (DD-MM-YYYY) or the last 4 characters of their PAN card.

customer_id.description: Unique database ID of the customer. Use 'cust_rahul_001' for Rahul Sharma.

dob.description: Customer's Date of Birth (e.g., '15-08-1990' or '15 August 1990').

last4PAN.description: Last 4 characters of customer's PAN card (e.g., '5241').
